# https://vellora.dynamisos.in

> Vellora Agency helps startups and growing businesses build websites, web and mobile apps, AI integrations, workflow automation, and SEO foundations.

## Services
- [Website design & development](https://vellora.dynamisos.in/services/websites): business websites, marketing sites, landing pages, redesigns, and content editing.
- [Web & mobile app development](https://vellora.dynamisos.in/services/apps): MVPs, customer portals, dashboards, and integrations.
- [AI development & automation](https://vellora.dynamisos.in/services/ai): AI assistants, knowledge search, product integrations, and business workflows.
- [SEO services](https://vellora.dynamisos.in/services/seo): technical SEO, on-page optimization, content planning, and performance reviews.
- [Ongoing support](https://vellora.dynamisos.in/services#support): maintenance, content updates, and integrations.
